subject: Follow-up: Evidence for PT fixes, configs, and compensating controls
messages:
From: Jed Collins <security@optimabank.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: RedTeam Labs <pen-test@redteamlabs.io>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for remediation evidence: OptimaBank PT findings

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for walking us through the pen test summary last week. Our security team is performing the final acceptance review and we need evidence for the fixes you've implemented against the high/medium findings in the report. Specifically we are looking for: 

- Screenshots showing the fixed UI/console/flags where applicable (annotated if helpful)
- Exact configuration snippets (firewall rules, WAF rules, IAM policies) with timestamps
- Links to change tickets / PRs showing the remediation work and approvals (JIRA preferred)
- Any compensating controls or temporary mitigations you relied on (and how long they will remain)

Can you provide a consolidated packet (PDF or Drive folder) and an index mapping each evidence item to the finding ID in the RedTeam report? Our target for closure is 2027-03-08; please let us know if that timeline works.

Attached: optima_pt_report_summary.pdf (from RedTeam Labs).

Thanks,
Jed Collins
Senior Security Manager
OptimaBank
security@optimabank.com

----
RedTeam Labs (pen-test@redteamlabs.io)
Original report reference: RT-20270228-OPTIMA

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Jed Collins <security@optimabank.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for remediation evidence: OptimaBank PT findings

Jed —

Appreciate the clear checklist. We will assemble an evidence packet that maps each RedTeam finding to the remediation artifacts. Proposed deliverables by 2027-03-05:

- Drive folder with screenshots (annotated) and plain-text config extracts
- Exported JIRA ticket PDFs for each remediation (REMED-1245, REMED-1246, REMED-1247)
- Short executive summary describing any compensating controls and intended permanence

Quick Qs: do you prefer a single consolidated PDF or a Drive folder with an index file? Also, would you like us to include packet hashes (SHA256) for integrity checks?

We expect to pull the artifacts from the fixes implemented last week; I'll coordinate with our SRE and security ops to get the configs and tickets. Will that timeline work for Optima?

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

- Marissa: export JIRA ticket PDFs for REMED-1245/1246/1247, include approval history and PR links (due 2027-03-03 EOD).
- Lauren: collect config snippets and firewall/WAF rule exports (include before/after where possible), annotate with timestamps (due 2027-03-03 EOD).

Please put package files in folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLinkOptimaEvidence and notify me when uploads are complete so I can produce final PDF and compute SHA256 hashes. We should also redact any customer data from screenshots.

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Jed Collins <security@optimabank.com>, RedTeam Labs <pen-test@redteamlabs.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence packet delivered — OptimaBank PT fixes (index + artifacts)

Jed —

Thanks for your patience. We uploaded the evidence packet to the Drive folder and attached key exports. Summary below, and a short mapping from RedTeam finding IDs to artifacts is included. Let me know if you need anything else for closure.

What we delivered (folder + attached PDFs):
- optima_fix_screenshots.zip — annotated screenshots for UI/console fixes (per finding)
- REMED-1245-ticket-export.pdf — JIRA export showing remediation, approvals, PR links
- fw-config-2027-03-02.txt — firewall rule before/after snippets with timestamps
- optima_pt_report_summary.pdf — original RedTeam summary (for reference)

Mapping (high-level):
- RT-FIND-001 (auth bypass): fixed via patch + config hardening; evidence: screenshot (screenshots/RT-FIND-001/*), REMED-1245-ticket-export.pdf page 2, fw-config-2027-03-02.txt lines 12-26
- RT-FIND-004 (exposed admin endpoint): removed endpoint + WAF rule; evidence: screenshots/RT-FIND-004/*, fw-config-2027-03-02.txt lines 34-41
- RT-FIND-007 (insufficient logging): logging retention and alerting added; evidence: REMED-1246 (in Drive), logging-sample-snippet.txt (in Drive)

Compensating controls and notes: 
- WAF rules applied at the edge for the affected endpoints; rules will be permanent and codified in our infra repo (PR links included in REMED ticket export).
- MFA enforced for admin access; temporary IP whitelisting used only during rollback window and removed 2027-03-03.
- Increased logging retention to 180 days for relevant services; alerts added to PagerDuty for abnormal patterns.

Integrity and traceability:
- Each file in the Drive folder has an accompanying SHA256 sum (index_sha256.txt).
- JIRA exports include the approval chain and PR links to the infra repo.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLinkOptimaEvidence
JIRA ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REMED-1245 (see exported PDF)

Attachments: optima_fix_screenshots.zip, REMED-1245-ticket-export.pdf, fw-config-2027-03-02.txt, optima_pt_report_summary.pdf

If Optima wants, we can also provide a short walk-through call next week to review the artifacts and answer technical questions.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
